meta.title: EN 1092-1 steel flanges, PN 16 (connection dimensions), DN15..DN600: flange OD D, bolt circle K, hole diameter L, bolt count
meta.standard: EN 1092-1 (CEN), paywalled. Connection dimensions only (D, K, holes, bolts) - identical for flange types 01/05/11 at a given PN/DN.

sources.S13: dodo FreeCAD workbench tablez/Flange_DIN-PN16.csv (LGPL-3.0, copy in data/dodo_Flange_DIN-PN16.csv). Columns: D = flange OD, d = bore, df = bolt circle, f = hole diameter, t = thickness, n = holes.
sources.S14: Wermac 'EN 1092-1 Type 11 weld neck flanges PN16', https://www.wermac.org/din/dim_wn_flg_pn16.html (search extract: DN100 row 220 / 180)
sources.S15: Ahlsell product listing, EN 1092-1 Type 11 weld neck PN40 DN100: D 235, K 190, 8 holes 22 mm, thickness 24 (search extract), https://www.ahlsell.se/en/products/heating-and-sanitation/steel-pipes-and-parts/steel-pipe-sections/weld-flange-pn-6-pn-100/1424191

notes: The full PN16 DN15..DN600 table is in dodo_Flange_DIN-PN16.csv; only the rows above are used by VCs.
PN16 and PN10 share connection dimensions up to DN150 in common catalogues (not verified here; not used).
